usage: 阿根廷 (aa3 gan1 ting4) is used as a proper noun referring to the country Argentina.
You can use 阿根廷 when talking about travel, culture, or sports related to the country.
It appears as a subject or object in sentences, just like other country names.
When mentioning 阿根廷, you can add verbs like '去' (go), '喺' (be at), or '鍾意' (like) for common phrases.
